signals.title: Food Lifeline network visits increased in FY2025

observations.text: Food Lifeline's FY2025 impact report lists 10,755,509 network visits for FY24 and 16,001,264 for FY25.
The reported increase is 5,245,755 visits, or approximately 48.77%, calculated from the two report values.

hypotheses.text: The scale of growth might create operational or data needs worth investigating, but no unmet need, budget, or buying intent is established.

limitations: First-party report only; report publication date is unknown.
Network visits are not unique people and do not establish organizational strain.

signals.title: Nurturing Roots funded workforce program

observations.text: South Seattle Emerald reports that Nurturing Roots' Future Food Systems program is supported by $85,260 from the Food Equity Fund.
The article describes Future Food Systems as training young adults ages 18–22 for food-system careers and responding to requests from former program participants.

hypotheses.text: A new funded workforce program may create operational or outcome-tracking questions worth investigating, but no unmet need or consulting budget is established.

unresolved_claims.text: The $85,260 award is available for outside operational or data consulting.

limitations: One local article; the city award record was not independently checked in this run.
Funding supports the program and does not establish discretionary consulting funds.
